findings.evidence: Basic.lean:122,137,152 defines the existing chart/local/domain predicates; Extension.lean:132–367 consumes IsLipschitzChartWith and GlobalExtension.lean:45,89 consumes IsLipschitzDomainWith. Neither name occurs in the new file. The roadmap requires a common predicate at PDE/README.md:246.
findings.fix: Consolidate the chart infrastructure and migrate consumers to the canonical interface; retain a uniform-constant domain predicate only for its distinct quantitative meaning, with proved connections to the new predicate.
findings.issue: IsLipschitzChart and IsLipschitzDomain (line 256) establish a disconnected second interface: existing extension results still require Set.IsLipschitzChartWith and Set.IsLipschitzDomainWith, and this file supplies no connection.
